description.value: You've been granted your own administrative assistant who uses drones to deliver you useful items for a nominal fee. You can use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Prescient Planner] even if you've already used it after purchasing goods, and you can use it as a single action instead of a 2-action activity, during which a corporate drone appears to deliver the item directly into your hand. In addition, five times per day, you can use Prescient Planner to pull out a common consumable item of up to 6 levels lower than your level.
